title: Kitchen Table Physics
desc: Counter-intuitive facts your kids will love arguing about

questions.q: If you fold a piece of paper in half 42 times, how far would it reach?
questions.a: Past the Moon — about 440,000 km (each fold doubles thickness)

questions.q: What percentage of the universe is made of the stuff we can actually see?
questions.a: About 5% — the rest is dark matter and dark energy

questions.q: Which planet has a day that's longer than its year?
questions.a: Venus — one rotation takes 243 Earth days, one orbit takes 225

questions.q: Humans share roughly what percentage of DNA with a banana?
Is glass a solid, a liquid, or something else?
questions.a: An amorphous solid — the 'glass is a slow liquid' thing is a myth

questions.q: What colour is a mirror, technically speaking?
questions.a: Slightly green — mirrors reflect green wavelengths most efficiently

questions.q: Sound travels faster through air, water, or steel?
questions.a: Steel — about 15 times faster than through air

questions.q: What happens to your height in space?
questions.a: You grow up to 5cm taller — your spine decompresses without gravity

questions.q: Can you see the Great Wall of China from space with the naked eye?
questions.a: No — it's too narrow. You can see cities, but not the Wall

questions.q: Your brain uses roughly what percentage of your body's energy?
questions.a: About 20% — despite being only 2% of your body weight
